notes:
## New features
- No new features in this focused maintenance release.

## Changes
- The update review releases its modal window before Save / Don't Save / Cancel and Save As. Cancel or a failed save returns to the review; a successful restart dismisses it before closing the application.

## Bug fixes
- Opening the inspector no longer changes a railway default behind the scenes, falsely marking an untouched project as unsaved or asking to save it when restarting for an update.
- Actual project, model and settings edits continue to receive unsaved-work protection.

Acoustic calculations and contour reconstruction are unchanged from 0.11.0. This patch uses focused UI/update regression and native lifecycle checks, not a repeated full acoustic suite. The macOS installer is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized.
